title: 🎉 Massive Mobile & UX Upgrade!
subject: 🚀 Imhotep Finance v8.2.0 - Native Mobile App, iOS Web UI, and Smarter Logins!

updates.title: New Android Mobile App
updates.description: We are thrilled to announce our official React Native mobile app! For the best experience and automatic updates, we recommend downloading it directly from the Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.imhoteptech.imhotep_finance

updates.title: Native-Like Web UI for iOS
updates.description: Apple users, we haven't forgotten you! The mobile web version has been completely overhauled to feel like a native app, featuring an intuitive bottom navigation bar, tailored safe-area paddings, and a compact dashboard.

updates.title: Smart Google Login Redirect
updates.description: Logging in with Google is now smarter. It will seamlessly redirect you directly into the native app if you have it installed, or automatically fallback to the web dashboard in 5 seconds.

updates.title: Places-Based Filtering
updates.description: Gain better insights into your spending by tracking where your money goes! You can now filter transactions by specific Places directly from the transactions page.

updates.title: Move Money & Currency Conversion
updates.description: Seamlessly transfer funds between different Places, and convert transaction amounts to your preferred currency using real-time exchange rates!

updates.title: Mobile App Widgets
updates.description: You can now add Net Worth and Monthly Report widgets directly to your phone's home screen on iOS and Android for quick financial insights.

updates.title: Simplified Self-Hosting
updates.description: Take full control of your financial data. We've introduced streamlined self-hosting capabilities with extensive documentation, making it easier than ever to run Imhotep Finance on your own server.

footer_note: We are constantly working to bring you the best financial tracking experience. Thank you for using Imhotep Finance! 💚
